02.0049: disapproved motion; flight or sleep in Kṣīrasvāmin

imperfect_plural: 3.4.111 gives jus after these ā-final roots according to Śākaṭāyana. The -ān path and the -uḥ path are separate readings of one 3pl imperfect position. The Mādhavīya explicitly denies carrying this particular optional substitution into the imperative by the resemblance of loṭ to laṅ.
ordinary_and_blessing_imperative: Plain yāhi, vāhi, drāhi, psāhi have optional tāt in the blessing condition of 7.1.35, which is available in 2sg and 3sg. The ṇ of drāṇi is licensed internally by root r, whereas all profiles already have the ṇ of the inner prefix.
four_semantic_histories: The Mādhavīya reads prāpaṇam for yā as motion; Kṣīrasvāmin illustrates vā with wind and gives both flight and sleep in explaining drā. The class-one drai entry remains a separate root.
